summary_en: 100,000 shares (0.76% of S/O ex-treasury) to be acquired on open market for ¥20M maximum. Execution window 3 Aug – 30 Sep 2026. Rationale: shareholder return and equity awards for directors and executive officers.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Terms for Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: ASTMAX Co., Ltd. announced on 31 July 2026 that its board has approved a buyback program to acquire up to 100,000 ordinary shares (0.76% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum outlay of ¥20 million. The acquisition will be executed via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE Standard) between 3 August and 30 September 2026. The company states that execution may be suspended or scaled back depending on market conditions. The stated purposes are to enhance shareholder returns and to secure equity awards for directors and executive officers. As of 31 July 2026, the company held 14,329 treasury shares out of 13,160,300 total issued shares.
